title: Ordinary BIT saving 0.003475458 via three finite leaf backends
body:

There is no self-call to the new backend, growing-depth limit, free weighted operation or inherited old precision/tape threshold. The sufficient uniform rank is larger; no practical speedup is claimed.

The complex supplier and selected whole kappa are unchanged. The claim retains the source analytic/native/compiler/complete-ordinary implementation hypotheses; no independent proof of integer multiplication, materialized uniform template or maintainer mathematical approval is claimed.
